correction: The fix of 9add100 added that a core above ExternalSizeMax is not kept. systemd-coredump compares the stored file size, which is the compressed size when it compresses, and it keeps the cores of PID 1 and journald whatever their size while storage is on. ADR-0032 now states only the capture limit and the stack text gate, and no retention rule.
